issues.description: Function fix_fix2float has inconsistent return types across repositories: tests/src/math_fix.h defines/implements fix_fix2float as returning double, while example_program/src/math_fix.h declares it as returning float and example_program/src/math_fix.c implements it as inline float. This mismatch between the test helper implementation and the example program API can confuse students about the expected type and precision and may produce warnings or subtle type-related surprises when reading or integrating code.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the return type of fix_fix2float across tests and example program. Preferred quick fix: change tests/src/math_fix.h to declare and implement fix_fix2float as float (matching example_program), and update any test code comments if necessary. Alternatively, if double precision is desired project-wide, change example_program/src/math_fix.h and example_program/src/math_fix.c to return double and update their prototypes/implementations accordingly. Ensure all headers, implementations, and callers use the same return type to avoid confusion and compiler warnings.
